title: Plan Upgrades, Contract Term Renewals, and Speed Tier Migration
summary: Rules for upgrading broadband and mobile tiers, contract loyalty discounts, and equipment compatibility requirements.

sections.heading: Broadband Upgrade Paths & Equipment Requirements
sections.text: Customers upgrading from Fiber 100 ($45.00/mo) to Fiber 500 ($65.00/mo) or Fiber Gigabit Pro ($85.00/mo) incur zero migration fees. Upgrades to Gigabit Pro require a NexusHub WiFi-6 Pro router; equipment upgrade is dispatched free of charge on a new 18-month agreement.

sections.heading: Contract Expiration Loyalty Discounts
sections.text: Accounts within 30 days of contract expiration, or currently on rolling month-to-month terms, qualify for loyalty tier pricing: Fiber 500 discounted to $55.00/mo (save $10/mo) or Fiber Gigabit Pro at $75.00/mo on an 18-month renewal.

sections.heading: Order Activation Lead Time
sections.text: Broadband speed tier upgrades are provisioned digitally at the BNG (Broadband Network Gateway) within 15 minutes if existing customer premises equipment supports the speed profile. No engineer visit is required for standard speed uplifts.
